{{NPC Infobox|image={{PAGENAME}}.png|name={{PAGENAME}}|location=[[Refugee camp]]|vendor=Bags and bag techs|money=1000|levelcostII={{Happiness||70}}|levelcostIII={{Happiness||100}}}}

The '''Tanner''' is part of the [[Game of Crone]] DLC. She arrives at the [[Refugee camp]] as the 11th refugee. Her questline will be available the next day.

==Quests==
The Tanner had to sell her shop and her workstation at [[The Town]] to repay her son's debt. She asks for you to build a [[Tanner's workplace|workplace]] for her at the [[refugee camp]], so she can make a few revenues here as well, because her belongings at [[The Town]] did not cover the debt entirely. Finishing this quest unlocks trading tier I.

After you get the [[Tanner's workplace|workplace]] ready for her, she will need a few more ingredients. She will ask you to build an [[Fence supplies for farm|animal farm]] for her. Fence supplies requires 24 [[Flitch]],12 [[Wood billet|Wood Billet]] and 12 [[Refugee Happiness]].Finishing this quest unlocks trading tier II.

For the [[Fence supplies for farm|animal farm]] to be functional, she'll ask you to settle a cow and hens. (You can get the cow from [[Rosa]] for {{Money|10000}} and the hens from the [[Fresh egg basket]] for {{Money|5000}}) Finishing this quest unlocks trading tier III and she'll give you {{Item|Recipe alchemists bag}}, {{Item|Recipe farmers bag}}, {{Item|Recipe fishermans bag}}.
